title: Der Film (Kunstgewerbemuseum Zürich)

title: weniger lärm
note: Swann Galleries auction lot image, German version (127x90 cm). Flat scan but only 727x1024; Galerie 1 2 3 has a larger scan of the Italian version ('meno rumore'), not used.

title: Musica Viva (Tonhalle-Gesellschaft Zürich, 12. Volkskonzert, 7 Jan 1958)
note: Swann Galleries auction lot image; printer City-Druck AG Zürich. Black circles on grey, concert text bottom.

title: Giselle (Basler Freilichtspiele)
note: Galerie 1 2 3 scan of an original print (Prix de l'affiche suisse copy).

title: Tell (Basler Freilichtspiele, Wilhelm Tell)
note: Galerie 1 2 3 scan of an original print; huge stepped 'TELL' letterforms over apple/arrow airbrush.

title: Pontresina Engadin
note: Galerie 1 2 3 scan; gallery dates it 1935 (often given as 1936). This copy carries Matter's pencil signature lower right.

title: Tokyo 1964 Olympics, official poster no. 2 (sprinters at the start)
note: Fonts In Use entry 'Tokyo 1964 posters' (image no. 2); flat scan. Photo Osamu Hayasaki, photo direction Jo Murakoshi. V&A/British Museum copies have no usable online image.

title: Tokyo 1964 Olympics, emblem poster (red sun, gold rings)
note: Walker Art Center, accession 1982.56; museum photograph rendered via Walker's imgix proxy (native 2460x4500, saved at 3000px long side). Thin dark backdrop edge.

title: Bring in 'da Noise, Bring in 'da Funk (The Public Theater)
note: Poster House PH.2025.491 (45x30 in version, 'Starts November 3rd', Newman Theater). Not the 1995–96 season poster (PH.5747, also titled Noise/Funk by Poster House) and not the 1996 Broadway/Ambassador version.

title: The Diva Is Dismissed (The Public Theater)
note: Cooper Hewitt 1996-88-17; 2048px rendition from images.collection.cooperhewitt.org (object id from Cooper Hewitt's public GitHub metadata; collection site itself is behind a verification page).

title: Anatomy of a Murder
note: Wikimedia Commons, public-domain US one-sheet scan.

title: Kunstgewerbemuseum Zürich: Schreibkunst
note: Galerie 1 2 3 scan; poster text reads 13 Juni–30 August 1981 (dealer lists it as 1980).

title: Das Schweizer Plakat 1900–1983 / L'affiche suisse
note: Galerie 1 2 3 scan; bilingual poster for Bruno Margadant's Birkhäuser book.

title: Books (Please)! In All Branches of Knowledge (Lengiz)
note: University of Edinburgh History of Art Image Library (teaching slide scan). Record dates it '1925 (1965)': this is Varvara Rodchenko's 1965 reconstruction of the lost original. Landscape format; black slide border included.

title: Cinemafrica (Filmtage, Filmpodium Zürich), 2006 edition
note: Cooper Hewitt 2007-15-3 (gift of the designer); 2048px rendition from the museum image server; museum photo includes grey backdrop margin.

title: McCoy Tyner Sextet (Jazz Festival Willisau, 3 April, Mohren)
note: Galerie 1 2 3 scan of an original screenprint.

title: Gran Premio dell'Autodromo, Monza (17 ottobre 1948)
note: Index Grafik design blog scan (Tumblr). Correct design, but whether this is an original 1948 print or the 1968 reprint (noted by AIAP) is unconfirmed; MfGZ and artnet records are behind bot-checks.

title: Victory 1945
note: People's Graphic Design Archive, image credit Mie Prefectural Art Museum; signed copy. Saved at the archive's own 2x display size (its resizer upscales arbitrarily, native size unknown).

title: Shigeo Fukuda exhibition, Keio Department Store 5F Art Gallery, Tokyo (alternating legs)
note: Walker Art Center, accession 1982.104 ('Poster for Art Gallery Tokyo, May 23 - May 28, 1975'); native 3165x4500, saved at 3000px.

title: negerkunst – prähistorische felsbilder südafrikas (Kunstgewerbemuseum Zürich)
note: Historical title recorded as-is. Museum für Gestaltung Zürich press image (© ZHdK) published by Eye Magazine; 2048px size from Eye's Flickr (photo 6812296157).

title: Die Konstruktivisten (Kunsthalle Basel)
note: Merrill C. Berman Collection essay page; image is a 1500x1500 square with white padding around the poster (poster itself about 1040x1500).

title: Nihon Buyo (UCLA Asian Performing Arts Institute)
note: Walker Art Center, accession 1982.155; native 3180x4500, saved at 3000px. This printing has English type only (no Japanese text).

title: Vormgevers (Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam)
note: Blanka (London design-poster gallery) Flickr scan. Visible grid, custom grid letters. MoMA, Stedelijk and SFMOMA copies not downloadable (bot-check or no image).

title: SMCS program poster (Stedelijk Museum CS), A2
note: From the studio's own archive (jetset.nl). Correct poster (= MoMA 361.2007) but small: 333x470, below the 800px target. MoMA and Stedelijk pages are behind bot-checks.

title: Beat the Whites with the Red Wedge
note: Wikimedia Commons, public domain; scan credited to the Russian State Library (chosen over a cleaner-looking redrawn reprint on Commons).
